connect.label: Your Sleeper username, or a league link
connect.where: Your username is the name you sign in to Sleeper with, not your team's name. A league's link is in the address bar of the league's page on sleeper.com: the long number after /leagues/ is the league id.

scoring.label: Scoring
scoring.words: the league's own scoring settings; a setting not priced here is listed on the league card

roster_slots.label: Lineup slots
roster_slots.words: every offensive slot, superflex included; IDP slots are left out and said so

matchups.label: Matchups
matchups.words: this week's opponent and every played week's points, in the league's scoring

players.label: Players
players.words: Sleeper's player directory, matched to nflverse ids for the projections

waivers.label: Waivers
waivers.words: free agents, and the claim type and time from the league's settings

transactions.label: Transactions
transactions.words: adds, drops and trades, from Sleeper's transactions

team_assets.label: Team assets
team_assets.words: team defenses are players; draft picks and waiver budgets are not read for a league opened on demand

news.label: News
news.words: ESPN's player news (most items RotoWire's), by player — the same on every platform

connect.label: Your MFL league link, id or name
connect.where: Open your league on the MFL website: the number after /home/ in the address is the league id (70587 in the example). In the MFL app, type the league's name as the app shows it.

scoring.label: Scoring
scoring.words: MFL's rules read into the projections' scoring; any piece estimated or not priced is listed on the league card

roster_slots.label: Lineup slots
roster_slots.words: starter ranges (2–4 WR) read as the minimum plus FLEX; IDP spots are left out and said so

matchups.label: Matchups
matchups.words: the schedule and each week's opponent; the week's live points are not read

players.label: Players
players.words: MFL ids matched to Sleeper's; a player with no match is listed by name and not valued

waivers.label: Waivers
waivers.words: free agents are the players no team rosters; MFL's waiver type is read, the claim time is not shared

transactions.label: Transactions
transactions.words: MFL's transactions are not read yet
transactions.unavailable: Transactions: not available for MFL leagues yet

team_assets.label: Team assets
team_assets.words: team QBs, kickers and defenses are priced as players; draft picks and blind-bid budgets are not read

news.label: News
news.words: ESPN's player news (most items RotoWire's), by player — the same on every platform

connect.label: ESPN leagues are not supported yet
connect.where: ESPN publishes no developer API or terms for fantasy leagues; a private league can only be read with the manager's own login cookies, which we will not ask for.
